brief: Map visible type evidence onto live catalog filters and fit targets. Fill every field from the reference, not from taste, then pass the file to scripts/rare_google_fonts.py set, which fills every role as one paired set.

criteria_fields.skeleton: feed skeleton the reference shows, such as Serif, Sans Serif, or Monospace
criteria_fields.width_class: reported width from 1 to 10 when the reference is condensed or extended
criteria_fields.weights: weights the hierarchy needs, as integers
criteria_fields.italic: true when the reference shows an italic or oblique cut
criteria_fields.scripts: subsets the copy needs, such as latin and latin-ext
criteria_fields.role: text, display, mono, or accent, which sets the legibility floor
criteria_fields.min_fit: lowest fit score to keep. Default 0.65
criteria_fields.min_legibility: raises the role floor. It can never lower the hard floor
criteria_fields.allow_common: true only with common_reason naming the evidence
criteria_fields.common_reason: why an overexposed default is the true fit

pairing: The set command runs the pairing check after the per role bars. A veto names the dimension that failed, and the next candidate takes the slot.
on_feed_failure: Stop and report. Do not fill a rarity block from memory or from an earlier snapshot.
